rules.name: A Candle 3 closure confirms the move when Candle 2 fails to produce the earlier reversal closure
rules.setupAnchor: After price reaches the mapped point of interest, compare Candle 3 against Candle 2 instead of forcing an early Candle 2 reversal read
rules.confirmationTrigger: Bullish Candle 3 closes above the body of Candle 2 and engulfs it, while bearish Candle 3 closes below the body of Candle 2 and engulfs it, after Candle 2 failed to deliver the needed reversal closure
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: The swing can only be promoted once Candle 3 supplies the delayed closure that Candle 2 failed to provide
rules.invalidationCondition: Candle 3 does not close through the Candle 2 body in the new direction, or Candle 2 had already qualified as a valid Candle 2 closure
rules.targetLogic: Once Candle 3 confirms, frame Candle 4 as the expected expansion candle in the new direction
exceptions: If Candle 2 already delivered the reversal closure, classify the sequence as Candle 2 rather than Candle 3
machineChecks: Reject the sequence if Candle 2 already qualifies as a valid Candle 2 reversal closure
Measure the Candle 2 body and require Candle 3 to close through it in the new direction
Emit a bullish or bearish Candle 3 closure state only after the delayed engulfing close appears

rules.name: A Candle 3 closure only matters when it appears at the mapped point of interest and inside the higher-timeframe idea
rules.setupAnchor: Map the fair value gap, imbalance, swing, or other point of interest first, then wait to see whether Candle 2 or Candle 3 gives the usable closure
rules.confirmationTrigger: Only accept Candle 3 as actionable when it forms at the point of interest and agrees with the higher-timeframe directional thesis
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: A swing point is ignored unless it has both ingredients: a real point of interest and a valid Candle 2 or Candle 3 closure
rules.invalidationCondition: Candle 3 closes through Candle 2's body away from the point of interest or against the higher-timeframe directional plan
rules.targetLogic: Use the valid point-of-interest-plus-closure pair as the structural anchor for the next continuation leg and lower-timeframe refinement
exceptions: If the point of interest was never mapped, the Candle 3 pattern is descriptive only and should not become a trade signal
machineChecks: Require a mapped point of interest before a Candle 3 closure can become actionable
Require higher-timeframe directional agreement before promoting the Candle 3 event into a valid swing
Ignore Candle 3 body-engulfing closes that occur in random mid-range locations
ambiguityNotes: The first-pass ranking rule for competing points of interest still needs a stricter algorithm

rules.name: After a valid Candle 3 closure, Candle 4 should respect the correct half of Candle 3's range
rules.setupAnchor: Mark the full wick-high-to-wick-low range of Candle 3 and compute its equilibrium immediately after the closure forms
rules.confirmationTrigger: In bullish conditions Candle 4 should wick into and respect the upper half of Candle 3, while in bearish conditions Candle 4 should wick into and respect the lower half of Candle 3 before continuation expands
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: The Candle 3 range and midpoint become the first refinement box that continuation must respect if the new swing is real
rules.invalidationCondition: Candle 4 fails to respect the intended half of Candle 3 or immediately breaks through the wrong side of the midpoint before continuation develops
rules.targetLogic: Use Candle 3 equilibrium as the refinement line, then anticipate Candle 4 expansion and lower-timeframe entries inside the respected half
exceptions: If Candle 4 never retests the intended half, the move can still continue but loses the cleaner equilibrium-based refinement described in the article
machineChecks: Measure Candle 3 equilibrium from wick high to wick low
Require Candle 4 to trade back into the correct half of Candle 3 for the equilibrium-refinement path
Flag loss of refinement when Candle 4 breaks through the wrong side of Candle 3 equilibrium before expansion confirms
ambiguityNotes: The minimum retest depth that counts as a valid wick into the correct half is not yet numeric

rules.name: No swing point is valid without both the point of interest and the closure event
rules.setupAnchor: Treat the point of interest as the location anchor and Candle 2 or Candle 3 as the event that upgrades the anchor into a real swing
rules.confirmationTrigger: Promote the swing only when price reaches the point of interest and then prints a valid Candle 2 or Candle 3 closure, followed by lower-timeframe displacement for entry refinement
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Protected structure is only meaningful after the point of interest and the qualifying closure have both appeared
rules.invalidationCondition: Either the point of interest is missing, the closure never forms, or lower-timeframe displacement fails to develop after the closure
rules.targetLogic: Once both ingredients are present, use the validated swing range to refine entries from higher timeframe down to 4-hour and 15-minute execution windows
exceptions: If Candle 2 produces the valid closure first, do not wait for Candle 3 just to preserve symmetry
machineChecks: Require both a point of interest and a qualifying closure before validating a swing
Allow either Candle 2 or Candle 3 to satisfy the closure requirement, but never neither
Hold the sequence in pending state until lower-timeframe displacement confirms the refined entry path
ambiguityNotes: The minimum displacement strength for the lower-timeframe refinement leg still needs a strict implementation rule

openQuestions: What body-overlap threshold is the best first numeric proxy for saying Candle 3 truly engulfed Candle 2 when Candle 2 is very small or doji-like?
What is the first useful numeric tolerance for saying Candle 4 respected the correct half of Candle 3 and produced enough lower-timeframe displacement to justify entry refinement?
